“Covered” means a complete correspondence at the recorded scope. “Partial” includes substantive
missing proofs and consequences not yet assembled from existing declarations. “Not mapped” means
that this source closure has no established complete declaration for the record. These statuses are not
a percentage of independent theorems: the records differ in scope and may share mathematical depen-
dencies.

2.1 Primary and semisimple constructions

text:
The verification receipt for the primary and semisimple constructions (archival identifier Block 08)
covers 54 production modules. It freshly compiled eight additions, authenticated 46 predecessor
source/object pairs, and replayed the whole logical closure. Its 1,634 source-owned entries comprise
1,627 logical declarations and seven separately inventoried generated partial runtime helpers. The lat-
ter were not proof-replayed. The recorded transitive axiom set is limited to propext, Classical.choice,
and Quot.sound. These quantities describe that receipt. It does not claim that all 54 source modules
were freshly compiled.

text:
The continuation proves the intrinsic primary quotient and generator count, the geometric for-
mula, scalar extension, and the six-way cyclic criterion. It also proves noncommutative module-top
reduction and the nonsplit semisimple formula, including actual compatible decompositions from the
Wedderburn–Artin existence theorem. The final existence theorems do not take a desired rank equality
or a compatible decomposition as an input. They are noncomputable mathematical constructions, not
executable decomposition algorithms.
